source_text: Apprehensi sunt adolescentes catechumini, Reuocatus et Felicitas conserua eius, Saturninus et Secundulus; inter hos et Vibia Perpetua, honeste nata, liberaliter instituta, matronaliter nupta. Habens patrem et matrem et fratres duos, alterum aeque catechuminum, et filium infantem ad ubera. Erat autem ipsa circiter annorum uiginti duo. Haec ordinem totum martyrii sui iam hinc ipsa narrauit, sicut conscriptum manu sua et suo sensu reliquit.
pass_a_gloss: Seized were young catechumens, Revocatus and Felicitas his fellow female slave, Saturninus and Secundulus; and among these also Vibia Perpetua, honorably born, instructed in liberal fashion, married in matronly fashion. Having a father and mother and two brothers, one likewise a catechumen, and an infant son at the breasts. She was about twenty-two of years. She herself narrated from this point on the whole order of her martyrdom, just as she left it written down by her own hand and by her own perception.
pass_b_english: Young catechumens were arrested, Revocatus and Felicitas his fellow slave, Saturninus and Secundulus; and with them also Vibia Perpetua, nobly born, liberally educated, and married as a matron. She had a father and mother and two brothers, one of them likewise a catechumen, and an infant son still at the breast. She herself was about twenty-two years old. She herself narrated from this point the whole course of her martyrdom, just as she left it in writing by her own hand and in her own understanding.

lemmas.gloss: persons under instruction, not yet baptized
in the manner of a freeborn education
in the manner of a married matron

choices.why: conserua is feminine nominative singular in apposition to Felicitas, and eius is masculine genitive referring back to Revocatus, so Felicitas is described as Revocatus's fellow slave
matronaliter is an adverb qualifying nupta and marks her social status as a respectably married woman, not merely that she was married

choices.english: in her own words and understanding
choices.why: sensus here means her own perception and expression, paired with manu sua to stress firsthand authorship
